about: Catalogue entries that are not open problems: remarks stated as facts in their source, or one-line consequences of the definitions, found by the statement reviews. Listed as known results; the desk does not hand them out.

oeis-a004767.reason: Kline's 'Collatz ascenders' remark is the elementary fact that an odd m ascends exactly when m ≡ 3 mod 4 (the companion of oeis-a016813, flagged by the second review); not an open problem.
